messages:
Jon Sales: Quick handoff for Nebula Health — closed today, expecting onboarding next week. 3-seat pilot, likely upgrade in 90 days. Renewal signal: medium (they budget quarterly, may push).
Marie CS: Thanks Jon. Can you drop the key customer context + required integrations here?
Jon Sales: TL;DR: HIPAA customer, wants Private VPC or dedicated. Must have SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and audit/export logs. Tentative go-live 2026-04-08. Main sponsor: Dr. Patel (CTO). IT lead: Maya.
Jon Sales: Known risk: their infra team insists on private control plane; procurement on a 30-day review. Budget ok but legal needs BAAs.
Marie CS: Got it. I'll own onboarding. Setting up kickoff Tues 4/7. Need eng/support for SSO & VPC checklist.
Luis CSM: I'll coordinate enablement docs and create a short eval prompt set for quality checks (PHI-safe prompts). Will share by EOD Mon.
Marie CS: @Sam Support / @Anya Eng — can you confirm capacity for a private eval cluster and SAML connector timeline? We need a dev proof-of-concept before prod.
Sam Support: We can stand up a private evaluation env but need infra request ticket with: customer name, required GPUs, expected concurrency, retention/purge policy. ETA 3 business days after ticket.
Anya Eng: SAML + SCIM connector: we have templates. If Nebula uses Okta, should be straightforward. I can allocate an engineer for initial smoke test Wed 4/1. Need test IdP creds.
Marie CS: Action: Jon please intro Maya to Anya and Sam via email with Okta test account + legal contact.
Jon Sales: Will do now. Email intro sent and pasted below.
Jon Sales: "Intro: Maya@nebulahc.com — Maya meets Anya (eng) and Sam (support) to scope SSO/VPC. Legal contact cc'd for BAA next steps."
OnboardBot: Reminder: create onboarding playbook in CS Confluence space and attach customer-specific checklist.
Luis CSM: I'll draft the playbook items (privacy, prompts, rollout phases) and assign owners.
Marie CS: Owners and next steps: 1) Legal/BAA (Jon) — open procurement follow-up by 3/31. 2) SSO/SCIM smoke (Anya) — test with Okta by 4/1. 3) Eval private env (Sam) — ticket by 3/29, provision by 4/1. 4) CS playbook & prompts (Luis) — draft by 3/31. 5) Kickoff call (Marie) — schedule for 4/7.
Sam Support: Noted. I'll create the infra ticket and tag @eng-runtime for quota checks.
Anya Eng: I'll reserve a half-day for the smoke test, ping if test IdP not available. Also: consider enabling prefix/KV caching for the eval workload to reduce cost — I can recommend settings after we see sample traffic.
Marie CS: Good call. Luis — please include sample traffic patterns in the playbook (expected prompt length, tokens per call).
Luis CSM: Will do. Also adding a short survey to capture user feedback during pilot (weekly collection).
Marie CS: Renewal/expansion notes: flagged medium risk now due to procurement/legal. Playbook will include milestone nudges and executive check-ins at 30/60/90 days.
Jon Sales: I'll monitor procurement and escalate to AE if reviews slip past 30 days.
Marie CS: Thanks all — I'll post the kickoff calendar invite and add the playbook link once draft ready. If anything blocks, DM me. :thumbsup: 
Sam Support: Copy. Opening ticket #INF-5421 now and adding the thread link.
Anya Eng: Thanks — will stand by for creds.
Luis CSM: Adding feedback capture template to the invite.
Marie CS: End of thread for now. We'll reconvene after SSO smoke.
